warnings: POINT ELEMENTS MERGED PER §4: each of F1/F2/C1/C2 appears exactly once with count + grid_refs, not one entry per position. grid_refs across F1 and F2 do not overlap, so 12 + 4 = 16 is a genuine total, not a double count. It matches the 16 columns drawn on the ชั้นล่าง plan (หน้า19 view2) position for position, and matches S-01/1's spread-footing plan position for position as well.

The footing and the pedestal are printed together on one label (F1,C1 / F2,C2), which is why the same grid_refs array appears on the footing entry and the pedestal entry. They are recorded as two elements because they are two different member types with different specs on S-03 - not as a double count of one thing.
F2 is drawn as a rectangle wider than it is tall while F1 is drawn square; no plan dimension is printed for either on this sheet. Sizes come from S-03. No size was invented here.

NO PILE COUNT IS SHOWN ON THIS PLAN. Each footing is drawn as an outline with a single small square at its centre (the pedestal), not as a pile group, so the number of piles per footing cannot be read from this sheet and is left absent rather than guessed. The pile itself is specified in the sheet notes (0.18x0.18, 21.00 m, ≥20 ตัน/ต้น).
Every grid_ref on this sheet resolves against the grid master. The two positions on the ง' line (ง'2, ง'4) are the front-porch columns; ค'1 is the single column on the west bay-window line.
